column2: Massachusetts Department of Public Health Wastewater Surveillance Data

This file contains wastewater surveillance data for SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19), Influenza, and RSV collected at public community monitoring sites across Massachusetts. Data are produced by the Bureau of Infectious Disease and Laboratory Sciences (BIDLS), Massachusetts Department of Public Health.
This file contains data from the current respiratory season and the prior season. Respiratory seasons run from July 1 through June 30.

Wastewater concentration data: Biobot Analytics (https://biobot.io) and the Massachusetts State Public Health Laboratory (DPH). Wastewater Viral Activity Level (WVAL) data: CDC National Wastewater Surveillance System (https://data.cdc.gov/resource/atcp-73re). Two normalized concentration columns are included in the Wastewater Data sheet, one for each lab's own normalization methodology (Biobot: proprietary effective concentration; DPH: PMMoV-normalized). These are not directly comparable to one another; see the Data Dictionary for details.

The MA WVAL Summary sheet contains DPH's calculation of the Massachusetts statewide Wastewater Viral Activity Level, derived as the median of site-level WVALs from the CDC NWSS dataset. This metric is used to classify signal levels in the dashboard. The underlying CDC NWSS site-level WVAL data is available at: https://data.cdc.gov/resource/atcp-73re

When citing these data please include the date the data were downloaded and attribute as: Massachusetts Department of Public Health, Bureau of Infectious Disease and Laboratory Sciences. Massachusetts Wastewater Surveillance Program. Biobot Analytics, https://biobot.io/data/
For questions about this data, contact the Massachusetts Department of Public Health Bureau of Infectious Disease and Laboratory Sciences.
